title: WooCommerce Migration
meta: Move products, customers and orders to WooCommerce from Shopify, Magento or others with links kept. From $250, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Store migration to WooCommerce, with orders and redirects
overview: We move your store to WooCommerce and keep the data that matters. We export your products, images, categories, customers and past orders, import them into your new shop and check variations, prices and stock. We set up redirects from old product links, rebuild your key pages and test checkout before the switch. You pick the launch moment, and we help with the domain change.

pkgs.blurb: A small catalog moved with images, categories and redirects.
Products, customers and orders moved, with shipping and tax rebuilt.
A larger move with variations, reviews and a careful switch-over.

faq: Which platforms can you move from?
Shopify, Magento, BigCommerce, Wix, Squarespace, PrestaShop and OpenCart are common. Send your store link and we confirm what can be moved by import and what is rebuilt.
Usually not, since platforms store them in ways that cannot be reused. Customers get a simple reset link on first login, and we help you write a friendly email about it.
Will I lose search rankings during the move?
We copy titles and descriptions and set 301 redirects so search engines follow your old links. No one can promise rankings, but a careful move protects most of them.
Do I need to keep my old store open?
Keep it live until the new shop is tested and approved. We tell you the right moment to switch the domain and when it is safe to close the old plan.
